retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key portrait of a musician with a cowboy hat and guitar, featuring dramatic red backlighting and centered-right slab serif text.
triggerTerms: cowboy hat silhouette with red light
excludeWhen: bright or high-key lighting is required
modern pop or electronic aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, high-contrast portrait of a man in a cowboy hat playing an acoustic guitar, set against a dark background with a deep red glow highlighting the silhouette. The subject is partially obscured by shadow, creating a somber and authentic atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third, facing right
Typography anchored in the dark negative space on the right
Red rim light defining the hat and shoulder against the black void
Guitar neck creating a horizontal leading line across the lower half
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting leaving the face mostly in shadow
Deep red and black color palette
Presence of a traditional cowboy hat and acoustic guitar

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a musician occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The highlighted edge of the cowboy hat and the musician's hands on the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red glow on the hat, moves down the face to the hands, and follows the guitar neck to the text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the right side and top, used for typographic placement.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red (rim lighting and atmospheric glow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and wood grain (subtle highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value, high contrast; saturation is concentrated in the red light.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to dark earth tones and deep reds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent slab serif family with varying weights and tracking.

preserve: Wide tracking on the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Classic slab serif with similar geometric weight.
Offers a similar sturdy but approachable slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat playing an acoustic guitar. Use a single red light source from the left to create a rim light effect on his silhouette. The right side of the frame should be almost entirely black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a bold, wide slab serif font in the center-right negative space. Below it, add the title in a smaller, medium-weight slab serif font, aligned to the left of the artist name.

verificationChecks: Is the face mostly in shadow?
Is there a distinct red rim light?
Is the text a slab serif?
Is the text placed in the right-side negative space?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Avoid showing the face clearly; maintain the low-key shadow
Do not use modern sans-serif typography

avoid: Bright, saturated colors other than red

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subject and background
Ensure the red light doesn't wash out the subject
Verify the slab serif font has appropriate weight
Confirm the composition follows the rule of thirds
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key musician portrait + red rim light + slab serif typography in negative space.
